description: Empirical cold-gas-efficiency (CGE) curve vs equivalence ratio (ER), plus per-feedstock CGE scaling from HHV. Numbers reused from EC143 F1b.
source: Basu (2010) Biomass Gasification; reused from EC143 F1b feedstock_db

CGE_design.note: Cold gas efficiency at design ER, dry wood

er_curve.comment: Cold gas efficiency vs equivalence ratio. Peaks near ER=0.25, falls at low ER (tar/char) and high ER (combustion).

feedstock_hhv.comment: HHV (MJ/kg dry) per feedstock, reused from EC143 F1b. CGE scales mildly with fuel quality (HHV/20).
